glosses: analgesic (of or relating to analgesic medicines)
Any medicine, such as aspirin, that reduces pain, especially without inducing a loss of other sensation. (Contrast anesthetic.)

examples.text: I am taking an analgesic. Is it safe to drink alcoholic beverages?
2010, Associated Press staff, Cadence signs option to buy Incline (original copy), Bloomberg Businessweek

glosses: Of or relating to analgesia; anodyne.
Acting to relieve pain; being an analgesic.
Of or relating to analgesia; anodyne.
